plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-03 legacy structured repeater row recovery

scope.defect: Legacy structured repeaters tolerated null/object/array row values by coercing them to empty text in the Inspector, so an unrelated edit could silently replace the stored row.
scope.behavior: The Inspector detects unrepresentable legacy list, tabs, accordion, gallery, and carousel rows. It exposes an accessible warning and one explicit per-row repair action; ordinary fields remain locked until repair. Valid neighbor rows and allowed null text fields are retained. Locked nodes cannot repair. The real browser also edits and saves a separate element while the malformed row exists, proving that an unrelated draft Save preserves the exact legacy row; Undo and Redo cover the explicit repair.
scope.history: Real Chromium verifies explicit recovery supports Undo and Redo without implicit writes.
scope.save_publish: A real browser uses the Editor draft route: an invalid saved draft remains untouched on opening; explicit repair changes only invalid rows; Save persists the draft and reload restores it while the old published snapshot remains unchanged; separate Publish is required before the repaired row is rendered publicly.
